PS I have huge respect for @elonmusk, but pumping #dogecoin is no longer cute. 

It's going to be really harmful to the investors who get burned, and the fiat-shilling legislators who use doge's inevitable collapse as an excuse to crush crypto.

Remember, kids, #dogecoin is the pet rock of crypto -- no new technology, no dev team, no use case, nothing backing it. A pure bubble. An insider's joke.

Anybody pumping it is an enemy of crypto who's just confusing newbies & attracting regulators
